text:
What is an advantage of manufacturing ethanol by fermentation?
A
The process is very fast.
B
The ethanol requires no separation.
C
The raw materials used are renewable.
D
There are no other products formed.

options.label: C
options.text: The raw materials used are renewable.

options.label: D
options.text: There are no other products formed.
